origins.live_capture: response of a real request to the official API, sanitized
origins.documented_sample: example copied from the official documentation
origins.synthetic: constructed fixture; never evidence for an unresolved provider gate

sanitization.addresses: every Base58Check/hex address except allowlisted official contracts is replaced by a keyed-HMAC synthetic address with a valid checksum; Base58, 41-hex and 0x-hex forms of one address map to the same synthetic address
sanitization.hashes: transaction and internal hashes are replaced by keyed-HMAC synthetic 32-byte hashes, consistently across files
sanitization.removed: labels/tags, address-keyed risk maps, market prices, third-party contact fields, permission/delegation detail, raw call data and signatures
sanitization.kept: blocks, timestamps, amounts, decimals, statuses, fee and resource fields

authentication.notes: Missing key: 401 text/html on key-required endpoints; invalid key: 401 JSON on every endpoint; anonymous access works only for some endpoints.

errors.notes: 400/401 and HTTP-200 empty/unrelated bodies observed live. 403, 429/Retry-After, 5xx and timeouts were not observed and are synthetic from the Common Errors page.

quotas.notes: Documentation gives no numbers and responses carry no rate-limit headers; no load test was run. Use the shared limiter and 429 back-off; do not invent QPS values.

balances.notes: accountv2 balanceStr plus account/tokens hidden=0&show=0; TRX is tokenId "_" with tokenType trc10; filter semantics differ from the documentation.

discovery.notes: Regular, TRC20 and internal feeds are all required; /api/transfer is redundant for TRX TransferContract rows.

pagination.notes: Offset cap, HTTP 400 beyond 10000, whole-second inclusive bounds, day-rounded counts, newest-first only. Single-block saturation was not observed.

/api/token_trc20/transfers.limits: No live saturated one-second window; stop incomplete if subdivision cannot exhaust it.

/api/internal-transaction.limits: limit=100 truncation not proven by the 17-row sample; always request documented limit=50.

/api/account/tokens.limits: 583 holdings across 200/200/183/0 rows; offset >10000 is not proven. Refuse a partial snapshot on unresolved saturation.

identity.notes: event_index from the event-log endpoint and internal_hash verified live. Two identical TRC20 transfers in one transaction were not observed; covered synthetically, and the contract does not depend on feed row multiplicity.

finality.notes: pending to confirmed verified live; failed calls verified live; revert=true never observed (synthetic).

fees.notes: Paid fee = transaction-list cost.fee; balances of 7 accounts reconcile to the sun. transaction-info cost.fee excludes energy and bandwidth fees. Memo fee only synthetic.

assets.notes: Official and fake USDT metadata live; catalog decisions in the design document.

addresses.notes: Base58Check and 0x/41 hex forms of the same address appear across endpoints.
